messages:
alex: quick thought — we should standardize fallback ordering for model variants so routing doesn't oscillate during quota spikes. currently some infra paths prefer v1 then v2, others prefer cheapest compatible.
mira: agree. want a single policy. main questions: telemetry labels, billing attribution, and console surface to override.
tj: what about sticky routing? if we change fallback order we might break affinity and cause client-side confusion.
sam: proposal sketch: default fallback_priority = [pinned_version, compatible_higher_perf, compatible_lower_cost] with console override and per-tenant opt-out.
alex: +1. example config: ```
service.routing.fallback_order = ["pinned", "v2-prefer", "v1-compat"]
```
opsbot: deploy-bot: canary toggle created: feature/variant-fallback-ordering (10% traffic) :rocket:
oliver: telemetry needs two counters: `routing.fallback_attempts` (labels: from_version, to_version, tenant) and `routing.fallback_success` (same labels). that will let us measure noise.
meera: billing question — if request goes to fallback model (cheaper), do we charge the original model quota or the model that served? finance prefers charge for serving model but product care about client-facing contract.
mira: let's charge served model. easier to reason about unit economics and aligns with infra cost. but we must surface in console per-route cost estimates.
tj: circuit-breaker: if fallback rate > 5% for 5m, revert to strict routing for that tenant and flag for manual review.
alex: agree on CB. also add a gradual rollout: console toggle + canary + auto-snapshot of telemetry at each step.
meera: UI: in console display a mini-heatmap: percent fallbacks by tenant + estimated cost delta. also badge routes with "fallbacks: 0.6%".
oliver: implement metric `compat.rollback_trigger` emitted when CB fires. we should also include sample requests (anonymized) in the incident details.
sam: edgecase: some clients depend on v1 token semantics. fallback must respect model-compat flags, and if incompatible, we must fail rather than fallback. add compatibility matrix check before routing.
alex: good catch. add `compatibility_check(request, candidate)` that can short-circuit fallback.
meera: UX question: do we expose per-tenant override in self-serve console or make it enterprise-only?
mira: make the toggle visible but annotate "enterprise-only: advanced quotas" and make changes audited + require admin.
tj: rollout plan: 1) infra impl + metrics; 2) canary 10% for non-enterprise tenants; 3) enable console visibility; 4) 25% -> 50% -> 100% with monitoring gates.
opsbot: deploy-bot: canary started at 10% (marker: feat/variant-fallback-ordering @ 2026-03-19T15:02Z)
alex: action items: oliver add counters & histograms, meera wire console badge, sam add compatibility matrix check, mira own rollout comms. I'll PR routing logic tonight.
mira: i'll draft the console copy and add a tooltip about billing implications.
sam: will add tests for token semantics and add e2e using our load simulator.
oliver: I'll add `route.fallback_latency` histogram too. want p50/p95 for fallback paths.
alex: final Q: do we want an experimental flag `prefer_v2_fallback=true` for dev tenants?
meera: yes, but opt-in only and visible. :thumbsup:
alex: ok, filing RFC and will link here. thanks all.
